title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: SSM Health / Saint Louis University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Palliative Care
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited residency in internal medicine, family medicine or a combined programme; board eligible/certified by the ABIM or the relevant American board
International applicants: International applicants with authentic interest in palliative medicine should contact the division to determine eligibility
Visa support: The division sponsors J-1 visas; H-1B visas are supported on an individual basis
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited hospice and palliative medicine fellowship at Saint Louis University, the first HPM fellowship programme in Missouri.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS)
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Palliative Medicine
Accreditation: Accredited by the ACGME (page also cites the American Board of Hospice and Palliative Medicine)
Application method: See the programme's Apply page for contact information and application instructions
Summary: Interdisciplinary hospice and palliative medicine fellowship in the UAMS Department of Internal Medicine providing supervised training in clinical and interpersonal skills.

title: Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) Heersink School of Medicine
Department: Division of Gerontology, Geriatrics and Palliative Care
Deadline: Applications accepted through ERAS June through May
Eligibility: Must be eligible for an Alabama medical licence, Alabama Controlled Substance Certificate and federal DEA registration; all USMLE steps completed at application; no minimum USMLE score
International applicants: IMGs accepted with a valid ECFMG certificate
Application method: ERAS only (NRMP codes 1007540F0 adult, 1007540F1 med/peds); participates in ERAS signalling; 3 letters of recommendation
Positions: 5 per year (4 adult track, 1 pediatric track)
Funding: Salary and benefits per UAB PGY level
Visa support: Division can sponsor J-1 visas; H-1B not sponsored unless the fellow is currently within the US
Licence requirement: Must be eligible for Alabama medical licence and Alabama Controlled Substance Certificate
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited palliative medicine fellowship training since 2000 at UAB Hospitals, the Birmingham VA Medical Center and Children's of Alabama.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
Department: Department of Palliative, Rehabilitation, and Integrative Medicine
Positions: 6 clinical fellowship positions (MD Anderson track and VA track)
Summary: ACGME-accredited hospice and palliative medicine fellowship with MD Anderson and VA tracks, including rotations at Houston Methodist Hospital and the Michael E. DeBakey VA.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: UT Health San Antonio (Long School of Medicine)
Department: Division of Geriatrics, Gerontology and Palliative Medicine
Deadline: ERAS typically opens mid-July for positions starting the following 1 July
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited residency in anesthesiology, EM, FM, IM, OB/GYN, pediatrics, PM&R, psychiatry, neurology, radiology or surgery
International applicants: Applicants must be US citizens, permanent residents or hold a J-1 visa; ECFMG certificate required for international graduates
Application method: ERAS; all positions offered through NRMP (NRMP #1722540F0); 3 letters including residency programme director, USMLE transcript
Visa support: J-1 visa holders eligible; other visas not mentioned
Summary: One of the largest US HPM programmes, supported by UT, the VA and University Health, offering adult, pediatric and 2-year geriatrics-palliative tracks.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship (BWH/MGH)
inst: Brigham and Women's Hospital / Massachusetts General Hospital (Mass General Brigham)
Department: Division of Sleep and Circadian Disorders
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited clinical sleep medicine training programme run jointly with Massachusetts General Hospital under Harvard Medical School faculty.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center
Department: Sleep Disorders Center
Summary: One-year multidisciplinary sleep medicine fellowship at the Dartmouth Hitchcock Sleep Disorders Center preparing fellows for sleep medicine board certification.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Stony Brook University Hospital (Renaissance School of Medicine)
Department: Division of Pulmonary, Critical Care and Sleep Medicine
Summary: Comprehensive one-year sleep medicine fellowship combining adult and pediatric sleep medicine at the University and Veterans Affairs sleep disorders centres.

title: Clinical Informatics Fellowship
inst: University of Wisconsin–Madison / UW Health
Department: Department of Medicine
Summary: Personalised clinical informatics fellowship with hands-on build, project leadership, research and industry immersion at UW Health.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship (Rush / Stroger)
inst: Rush University Medical Center and John H. Stroger Jr. Hospital of Cook County
Department: Rush University GME / Cook County Health
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME- or AOA-accredited residency in an HPM-eligible field; board eligible or certified in the primary discipline; able to obtain an Illinois medical licence and DEA certification by the start of fellowship
Licence requirement: Must qualify for an Illinois medical licence and DEA certification by fellowship start
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship run jointly by Rush University Medical Center and Stroger Hospital, with dedicated weekly academic time and a faculty mentor for each fellow.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Chicago Medicine
Department: Department of Medicine, Section of Geriatrics & Palliative Medicine
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME- or AOA-accredited residency in anesthesiology, EM, FM, IM, neurology, OB/GYN, pediatrics, PM&R, psychiatry, radiology or surgery
Visa support: Page refers applicants to UChicago GME for contract, stipend and visa policies
Summary: One-year clinical HPM fellowship with block rotations in inpatient consultation, home hospice, pediatric palliative care at Advocate and Comer Children's, long-term care and electives.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Stony Brook University Hospital (Renaissance School of Medicine)
Department: Division of Hospice and Palliative Medicine
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited residency in one of the ten ABMS specialties that accept HPM as a subspecialty
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited fellowship training physicians to become leaders in academic palliative medicine at Stony Brook University Hospital.

title: Hospice & Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Stony Brook Southampton Hospital
Department: Stony Brook Medicine (community-based academic programme)
Application method: ERAS applications only; all applicants ranked and matched through NRMP
Summary: Community-based academic HPM fellowship on the East End of Long Island within the Stony Brook Medicine system.

title: Hospice & Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Thomas Jefferson University (Sidney Kimmel Medical College)
Department: Department of Family & Community Medicine, Division of Palliative Care
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited hospice and palliative medicine fellowship run by Jefferson's Division of Palliative Care.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Penn State Health Milton S. Hershey Medical Center
Department: Department of Medicine
Application method: ERAS only, following NRMP Specialties Matching Service policies and schedules
Funding: Stipends and benefits per Penn State Health GME
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship at Hershey Medical Center with away rotations at Lebanon VA Medical Center, Hospice of Central Pennsylvania and Oak Hill Village.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Fox Chase Cancer Center / Temple University Hospital
Department: Supportive Oncology and Palliative Care Program
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited fellowship with Temple University Hospital emphasising palliative care in oncology and outpatient palliative skills.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Wake Forest University School of Medicine / Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Section of Gerontology and Geriatric Medicine
Funding: Competitive salary based on completed residency PGY level plus standard Wake Forest fellow benefits
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship established in 2003 with clinical exposure at Wake Forest Baptist, Brenner Children's, Novant Forsyth, Trellis Supportive Care and Mountain Valley Hospice.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Atrium Health (Levine Cancer Institute / Carolinas Palliative Care and Hospice Group)
Department: Department of Supportive Oncology, Levine Cancer Institute
Duration: 1 year clinical track, or 2-year academic track (HPM year 1 ACGME; Supportive Oncology year 2 non-accredited)
Deadline: Applications preferred by 1 September; interviews August–October
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited residency in an HPM sponsoring specialty (IM, FM, pediatrics, anesthesiology, EM, neurology, etc.)
Application method: ERAS; NRMP participants; 3 letters including one from Programme Director or Chair
Summary: ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship combining Levine Cancer Institute's Department of Supportive Oncology with Carolinas Palliative Care and Hospice Group, with an optional second supportive-oncology year.

title: Palliative Medicine & Hospice Fellowship
inst: University of Cincinnati College of Medicine
Department: Department of Family and Community Medicine
International applicants: Page states fellows are recruited locally though applicants apply from a national pool
Summary: Hospice and palliative medicine fellowship in UC's Department of Family and Community Medicine aiming to be the regional leader in HPM training.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Summa Health System
Department: Department of Internal Medicine
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (among the first HPM programmes accredited, instituted 2006)
Summary: One-year HPM fellowship based in Summa Health's Department of Internal Medicine, one of the first ACGME-accredited HPM programmes.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Minnesota Medical School
Department: Department of Family Medicine and Community Health
Duration: 1 year (pediatric track alternates fellowship and primary-site blocks)
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship with adult and pediatric tracks training at community and academic sites in interprofessional teams.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Rochester Medical Center
Department: Multidisciplinary (Neurology, Pediatrics and Pulmonology faculty)
Eligibility: Primary training in neurology, family medicine, internal medicine (with or without pulmonary/critical care), otolaryngology, pediatrics, anaesthesia or psychiatry
Summary: Multidisciplinary ACGME-approved sleep fellowship covering adult and pediatric sleep medicine with exposure to CBT-I and hypoglossal nerve stimulation.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Thomas Jefferson University (Sidney Kimmel Medical College)
Department: Department of Psychiatry & Human Behavior
Summary: Academically based sleep medicine fellowship at the Jefferson Sleep Disorders Center within the Department of Psychiatry & Human Behavior.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Vanderbilt University Medical Center
Department: Department of Neurology, Division of Sleep Medicine
Eligibility: Completed residency in an ACGME-accredited programme in internal medicine, neurology, pulmonary, psychiatry, pediatrics, family medicine or otolaryngology and board eligible
Summary: Multidisciplinary ACGME-accredited sleep fellowship featuring an AASM-accredited hotel-based sleep laboratory for adults and children.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Wake Forest University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Neurology
Funding: Competitive salary based on completed residency PGY level plus standard Wake Forest fellow benefits
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited sleep fellowship across all ages at an AASM-accredited centre with eight adult and two pediatric sleep beds.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Duke University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Neurology
Eligibility: Completion of an ACGME, CFPC or RCPSC accredited residency in neurology, child neurology, psychiatry, IM, FM, pediatrics, otolaryngology or anaesthesiology
Funding: Salary commensurate with experience (e.g. 3-year IM graduates paid at PGY-4)
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited sleep fellowship split between Duke University Medical Center and the Durham VA, emphasising sleep test interpretation.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Iowa Hospitals & Clinics (Carver College of Medicine)
Department: Department of Neurology
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited residency in neurology, child neurology, anaesthesiology, FM, IM, otolaryngology, pediatrics or psychiatry; meet Iowa Board of Medicine licensure requirements
International applicants: Valid ECFMG certificate required for graduates outside the US/Canada
Application method: ERAS and NRMP; 3 letters including residency programme director
Licence requirement: Must meet Iowa Board of Medicine licensure requirements
Summary: Sleep medicine fellowship in Iowa's Department of Neurology offering two competitive positions each year.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: Rush University Medical Center
Department: Rush Sleep Disorders Center
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited; also includes ACGME pilot blended pathway with pulmonary and critical care
Application method: ERAS and NRMP; CV, cover letter, personal statement and 3 letters; interviews from September
Visa support: Accepts H-1B and J-1 non-immigrant IMGs
Summary: Long-standing sleep medicine fellowship (since 1995) at the Rush Sleep Disorders Center with ACGME accreditation for two fellows a year.

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Nebraska Medical Center (UNMC)
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Pulmonary, Critical Care & Sleep Medicine
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited multidisciplinary sleep medicine fellowship administered by UNMC's pulmonary division with Nebraska Medicine.

title: Addiction Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill School of Medicine
Department: Department of Psychiatry
Funding: Page states the programme provides full financial support for its fellows
Summary: Addiction medicine fellowship in UNC's Department of Psychiatry, created in 2018, with no call or weekend duties and fellows from many primary specialties.

title: Addiction Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Minnesota Medical School / Hennepin Healthcare
Department: Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
Eligibility: Open to physicians of all specialties; completion of an ACGME residency
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (and American Board of Addiction Medicine)
Application method: ERAS; Medicine and Pediatric Specialties Match
Summary: One-year addiction medicine fellowship hosted by the University of Minnesota Medical Center with training at Hennepin Healthcare.

title: Addiction Medicine Fellowship
inst: Trinity Health Ann Arbor Hospital
Department: Internal Medicine Fellowships, Graduate Medical Education
Summary: Community-hospital addiction medicine fellowship, the first ABAM-approved fellowship in Michigan (2013), with inpatient and outpatient training including IHA Recovery.

title: Addiction Medicine Fellowship
inst: UCLA Health (David Geffen School of Medicine at UCLA)
Department: Department of Family Medicine
Eligibility: Board certified/eligible; preference to FM, IM, pediatrics and EM, other primary specialties welcome
Summary: One-year clinical addiction medicine fellowship based at the UCLA Family Health Center in Santa Monica with training at UCLA, the West LA VA and community programmes.

title: Addiction Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS)
Department: Department of Psychiatry
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (leads to ABPM addiction medicine board eligibility)
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited addiction medicine fellowship in the UAMS Department of Psychiatry with faculty in addiction medicine and addiction psychiatry.

title: Clinical Informatics Fellowship
inst: Vanderbilt University Medical Center
Department: Department of Biomedical Informatics
Eligibility: ABMS board certified or board eligible in a primary specialty by fellowship start
Summary: Two-year ACGME-accredited CI fellowship combining an MS in Applied Clinical Informatics with operational experience across Vanderbilt Health and HealthIT.

title: Clinical Informatics Fellowship
inst: The MetroHealth System / Case Western Reserve University
Department: Center for Clinical Informatics Research and Education
Deadline: Applications received by 31 October (midnight EST) are reviewed
Eligibility: Completed two years of an ACGME, RCPSC or CFPC accredited residency (and board eligibility requirements as stated)
International applicants: Yes - international applicants accepted if they meet eligibility; ECFMG certificate required for foreign graduates
Application method: ERAS (July cycle); AMIA match; virtual interviews
Visa support: Sponsors H-1B visas (Step 3 scores required by 1 December for H-1B eligibility)
Summary: Two-year ACGME-accredited CI fellowship based at MetroHealth with informatics experience at Cleveland Clinic and University Hospitals.

title: Clinical Informatics Fellowship
inst: Duke University Health System
Department: Department of Biostatistics & Bioinformatics (academic sponsor)
Eligibility: US board certified or eligible physicians
Summary: Two-year ACGME-accredited fellowship blending business, informatics and leadership training for physicians at Duke.

title: Clinical Informatics Subspecialty Fellowship
inst: Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU)
Department: Division of Informatics, Clinical Epidemiology and Translational Data Science (Department of Medicine)
Deadline: Applications open each July via ERAS for positions starting the following July
Eligibility: Board-eligible or certified in a primary specialty after an ACGME-accredited residency
International applicants: IMGs may apply if board-eligible/certified in a primary specialty and trained in an ACGME-accredited residency
Application method: ERAS only (Clinical Informatics (Internal Medicine), July cycle)
Summary: One of the first US CI fellowships (2014), combining operational informatics training with the OHSU Graduate Certificate in Biomedical Informatics.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship (Interprofessional Palliative Care Program)
inst: MedStar Washington Hospital Center / Georgetown University School of Medicine
Department: Division of Palliative Medicine
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited physician HPM fellowship nested within MedStar Washington Hospital Center's interprofessional palliative care training programme.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: University of New Mexico School of Medicine
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Palliative Care
Deadline: Applications received from 15 July (2025 for the 2026–2027 year)
Eligibility: Board-eligible or board-certified in an HPM-eligible primary specialty (recent fellows from EM, FM and IM)
Application method: ERAS; positions filled through NRMP; letter from programme director (or department chief for mid-career applicants)
Summary: 12-month ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship addressing physical, emotional, spiritual and cultural suffering with a mission focus on vulnerable New Mexico populations.

title: Hospice and Palliative Fellowship
inst: University of Arizona College of Medicine – Phoenix
Department: Graduate Medical Education (Banner – University Medical Center Phoenix)
Summary: One-year multidisciplinary HPM fellowship using Banner – University Medical Center Phoenix, the Phoenix VA Medical Center and Phoenix Children's Hospital.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Maine Medical Center (MaineHealth)
Department: Palliative Care Program
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship at Maine Medical Center's Portland campus with four positions a year.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Northern Light Eastern Maine Medical Center
Department: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Program
Eligibility: Completed (or completing) an ACGME-accredited residency in anaesthesiology, EM, FM, IM, neurology, OB/GYN, pediatrics, PM&R and other HPM-eligible specialties
Summary: ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship at Eastern Maine Medical Center leading to board eligibility in hospice and palliative medicine.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Interprofessional Fellowship
inst: Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center (Dartmouth Health)
Department: Section of Palliative Care, Department of Medicine
Duration: 1 year (optional 2-year Leadership Preventive Medicine Residency track afterwards)
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited since 2008; APP fellowship accredited with distinction (2023)
Summary: Interprofessional HPM fellowship training physicians side-by-side with advanced practice providers at Dartmouth Health.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: Brown University Health / Warren Alpert Medical School of Brown University
Department: Department of Medicine, Division of Geriatrics and Palliative Medicine
Eligibility: Completed or completing an accredited residency and board certified/eligible; applicants without an ACGME-accredited residency are not considered
International applicants: Applicants who have not completed an ACGME-accredited residency are not eligible
Application method: ERAS (via the Match); CV, 3–4 letters (one from programme director or chair), personal statement, USMLE transcript
Summary: One-year clinically intensive ACGME-accredited HPM fellowship at Brown with an Arts and Ethics in Palliative Care curriculum.

title: Hospice and Palliative Medicine Fellowship
inst: West Virginia University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Medicine, Section of Geriatrics, Palliative Medicine and Hospice
Summary: HPM fellowship based at the 690-bed WVU Hospital, a quaternary referral centre serving rural Appalachian West Virginia.
